# MANA

> MANA is an influencer and talent management agency in Melbourne, Australia. It represents Australian content creators Hugo Zbor, Kevin Chiang and Preston Young and runs their brand partnerships from brief to final post.

MANA is based in Melbourne, Australia, and works with brands in Australia and worldwide. Brands contact MANA for creator media kits and campaign briefs; rates are shared on request, not published.

## Creators
- Hugo Zbor (@hugozbor, Creative direction, green-screen and 3D): Green-screen concept films for Converse, ASICS and Named Collective, from idea to final cut.
- Kevin Chiang (@kevnchiang, Architecture, design and lifestyle): Architecture and design content for students, young architects and creatives aged 18 to 34.
- Preston Young (@by.preston, Life lessons, lifestyle and self-growth): Cinematic, story-led reels on life lessons, student life and training.

## Selected work
- One reel, 100+ paid sign-ups, Kevin Chiang × Suapp: An organic reel showing Suapp’s SketchUp plug-in to architecture students. No boost. (490K+ views, 29K saves)
- A green-screen film, then a second, Hugo Zbor × Converse: Idea to final composite by one creative. Converse re-booked him for a second. (2 videos, Re-booked)
- Ichi-go Ichi-e: 2.9M views, Preston Young · organic: One idea told in under a minute. The reach a brand placement sits inside. (58.2K shares, 284K likes)

## Who runs MANA
- Sheik Anam Milfer (Shei), founder and talent manager. MANA is run by Shei (Sheik Anam Milfer), who started it in Melbourne in April 2026 and manages the roster himself. Born and raised in Hong Kong, based in Melbourne. He is an engineer by training and builds the agency’s own systems for briefs, deals and approvals. That is why brands deal with one person from the first email to the final post, and why nothing a brand agreed to gets lost between the brief and the live date.
